locations.title: Harry Potter/Minecraft/Gold Train Easter Eggs
locations.description:
At the train tunnel covered in debris, there will be text on the wall saying 9 and 3/4 that you can walk through, a reference to Harry Potter. 

After walking through the wall, you'll need to break some blocks - a reference to Minecraft.

Finally, you'll find a golden train - a reference to the Nazi gold train urban legend.

locations.title: Helipad & Multiple NPCs
locations.description:
**CONTAINS SPOILERS**

**Location:** Requires mods to reach, as it is outside the playable area and is surrounded by a damage barrier that instantly kills the player.

**Loot:** Various weapons, ammo, and med kits.

**Notes:** During normal gameplay, the only time this location is accessed is during the final section of the final story quest, [The Last Supper](). On the helipad are NPCs of Aiden, Lydia, and the beast version of the Baron. Although all three are in idle animations, they are static and do not react to anything.

Behind a locked (Hard) door, you'll see a Volatile nest separated from you by another door, with a broken window.

This is a callback to a similar easter egg in Dying Light 1, and just like in that game, interacting with the door here will start a chase with a whole lot of volatiles.
